Asked Questions for the emergency amendment, which noted that any logical or physical resources that are internal or external to an aircraft and contribute to its airworthiness are excluded from the scope of the emergency amendment. Additionally, according to the aviation stakeholders we interviewed, the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024’s provision that grants FAA exclusive authority to regulate the cybersecurity of civil aircraft helped to provide some clarity.

As previously mentioned, FAA has clearly defined its role and responsibilities for the cybersecurity of avionics and the ground systems it operates in the NAS.
